entities.summary: Huang Xuhua was a Chinese mechanical engineer, and the second chief designer for the country's first generation of nuclear submarines. He was director emeritus of the Wuhan-based 719 Research Institute of the China Shipbuilding Industry Corporation, and was an academician of the Chinese Academy of Engineering. His name was classified until 1987.
